facts.fact: Businesses with photos on their Google Business Profile receive 42% more requests for directions, according to the page.
facts.quote: Businesses with photos receive 42% more requests for directions and 35% more click-throughs to websites.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's free plan is described as supporting up to 500 contacts, per the article.
facts.quote: Mailchimp (free up to 500 contacts) or similar platforms.

facts.fact: The article recommends posting social media at least 3-5 times per week as a minimum for algorithm consistency.
The article states Facebook pages reach roughly 2-5% of followers per post organically.
facts.quote: Facebook pages reach maybe 2-5% of followers per post.

facts.fact: The article recommends committing to at least one blog or content piece per month for six months before evaluating results.
facts.quote: commit to at least one piece per month for six months before evaluating results.

facts.fact: The article uses a conservative estimate of $50 per hour as the value of a business owner's time, making 10 hours of free marketing a $500 opportunity cost.
facts.quote: If your time is worth $50/hour (conservative for many business owners), 10 hours of "free" marketing costs you $500 in opportunity cost.

facts.fact: The page advises starting Google Ads at $5-10 per day targeting specific keywords.
The page states that Facebook and Instagram ads can be started at $5 per day.
facts.quote: Facebook and Instagram let you start at $5/day.

facts.fact: The page says sponsoring a community event can cost $50-100 and get a business's name in front of hundreds of neighbors.
facts.quote: Sometimes $50-100 sponsoring a community event gets your name in front of hundreds of neighbors.

facts.fact: Adwave claims its streaming TV ads can be run starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: run TV ads starting at just $30 a day

facts.fact: The page recommends a small budget of $50-100 for testing one paid channel in months 3-4 of a marketing plan.
facts.quote: while testing one paid channel with a small budget ($50-100).

facts.fact: The page states free advertising typically takes three to six months of consistent effort to generate meaningful results.
facts.quote: Free advertising typically takes three to six months of consistent effort to generate meaningful results.
